all_candidates.topic: Should recent fuel price hikes be immediately reversed?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Petrol and diesel prices were increased across India multiple times, including a significant hike on September 15, 2026, marking the fourth increase in 10 days.

all_candidates.topic: Should merchants absorb new UPI transaction charges?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The NPCI introduced a 0.4% Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) on UPI Person-to-Merchant (P2M) transactions above ₹2,000, effective October 15, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Should small merchants be fully exempt from UPI MDR?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The new UPI MDR framework, announced this week, exempts merchants receiving up to Rs 100,000 monthly via QR codes, but imposes 0.4% MDR above Rs 2,000 for others.

all_candidates.topic: Will new UPI merchant fees lead to higher consumer prices?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The government clarified this week that consumers won't directly pay the new 0.4% MDR on UPI transactions, but merchants might factor costs into prices.

all_candidates.topic: Could new UPI fees lead to more cash transactions?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Critics, following the announcement this week of a 0.4% MDR on high-value UPI merchant transactions, worry that merchants might prefer cash for larger payments.

all_candidates.topic: Should India discontinue daily fuel price revisions?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Despite daily revisions, fuel prices remained steady in major cities on September 16, 2026, following recent hikes in the last 10 days.

all_candidates.topic: Should NEET and JEE merge into a single national exam?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Discussions on a 'One Nation, One Exam' framework, potentially merging NEET and JEE, are part of proposed reforms for 2026-2027 by the NTA and Ministry of Education.

all_candidates.topic: Should temporary bank account holds be capped at 60 days?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The RBI proposed on September 14, 2026, a 60-day limit for temporary debit holds on bank accounts suspected of cyber fraud, following a Supreme Court directive.

all_candidates.topic: Is the online real-money gaming ban effective against black markets?
all_candidates.news_anchor: A September 12, 2026, report highlighted the continued survival and shapeshifting of online gambling through black markets, despite the 2025 ban.

all_candidates.topic: Should UPI apps clearly show the MDR charged to merchants?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The NPCI introduced a 0.4% MDR on high-value UPI transactions this week, with the government clarifying it's a merchant charge, not directly for consumers.

all_candidates.topic: Is the new UPI MDR crucial for ecosystem growth?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The RBI supported the new 0.4% MDR on high-value UPI transactions, announced this week, citing long-term sustainability and investment needs for the digital payments ecosystem.

all_candidates.topic: Should E20 petrol be capped for existing vehicles?
all_candidates.news_anchor: On September 9, 2026, a PM aide indicated that ethanol blending beyond 20% (E20) for existing vehicles might not be increased, suggesting higher blending only for flex-fuel vehicles.

all_candidates.topic: Should E20 become standard for all vehicle types?
all_candidates.news_anchor: A PM aide stated on September 9, 2026, that higher ethanol blending beyond E20 for existing vehicles would likely require flex-fuel technology.

all_candidates.topic: Is removing TV ad time limits good for viewers?
all_candidates.news_anchor: TRAI withdrew an order on September 14, 2026, after the government removed the 12-minute-per-hour advertising ceiling for TV broadcasters.

all_candidates.topic: Should E20 fuel damage void older vehicle warranties?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Ongoing concerns over E20 petrol's impact on older vehicles are highlighted by a PM aide's comment on higher blending for existing vehicles on September 9, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Should AI-powered voice assistants become subscription-based?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Amazon launched its AI-powered Alexa+ service in India this week (September 16, 2026), with plans for a monthly fee for non-Prime members.

all_candidates.topic: Will advanced AI assistants improve daily Indian life?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Amazon launched its new AI-powered Alexa+ service in India this week (September 16, 2026), aiming to make the assistant smarter and chattier for users.

all_candidates.topic: Is DPDP Act implementation too slow for data safety?
all_candidates.news_anchor: News on September 16, 2026, discussed the operationalization of the Data Protection Board, noting that the main compliance provisions of the DPDP Act are set for May 2027.

all_candidates.topic: Does the DPDP Act sufficiently empower users to delete data?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The DPDP Rules, notified in November 2025, outline users' right to erase or modify data, with the Data Protection Board's operationalization discussed on September 16, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Is India prepared for the DPDP Act's technical demands?
all_candidates.news_anchor: A September 14, 2026 report highlighted India's privacy engineering gap, as companies struggle to find professionals to implement the technical controls required by the DPDP Act.
